subject: Jerin
text: Jerin joins the party at the Lost Forest Guide Station at Level 14.

evidence.quote: Well, Jerin pops up to save the day this time, and you get her on your party. She's pretty weak, at Level 14, and has crappy armor.

subject: Surinagal
text: Hi Potions can be purchased at the store in Surinagal.

evidence.quote: What's cool here, though, is that for the first time in the game, you can actually buy Hi Potions at the store!

subject: Emerald
text: An Emerald can be taken from the cupboard in the jeweler's shop in Ruan.

evidence.quote: The jeweler has some interesting info on the Medan Mine, and you can take an Emerald from the cupboard.

subject: blooming flowers
text: Checking the middles of the blooming flowers in the lower right corner of Ruan yields a Power Potion and an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Another weird thing, down in the right corner, check the middles of the blooming flowers to find a Power Potion and Empty Bottle.

subject: Jerin
text: Jerin knows the WARP spell, which allows warping to any previously visited town.

evidence.quote: Check Jerin's spells. . .she has one called "WARP". This allows you to warp to any previously visited town!

subject: Crown
text: In Grenoble, you can enlist to find the Crown for 2000 Gold.

evidence.quote: In Grenoble, enlist to find the "Crown" for 2000 Gold.

subject: Old Cave
text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave, entering the room up the upper left passageway leads to a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Then head to the Old Cave and go to Floor 4. Take the treasure, then go up the upper left passageway and into a room for a Miracle.

subject: muck puddle
text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave, a Spell Potion is hidden in the muck puddle on the left-most row, third down from the top.

evidence.quote: Go all the way right once you are back in the main room, and you'll reach a big muck puddle. There is a Spell Potion hidden on the left-most row, third down from the top.

subject: muck puddle
text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave near the muck puddle, you can collect the Broad Rod and the Crown.

evidence.quote: Take the Broad Rod and the Crown, and then head back.

subject: left room
text: In the Blue Tower, the Blue Ring is located in the left room.

evidence.quote: Go in and head to the left room and pick up the Blue Ring.

subject: right room
text: In the Blue Tower, a Magic Guard is located in the right room.

evidence.quote: Check the right room for a Magic Guard.

subject: left path
text: In the Blue Tower, going down the left path leads to Sweet Water at the bottom.

evidence.quote: Go down the left path and take the Sweet Water at the bottom.

subject: Blue Tower
text: Falling off the sides of the Blue Tower causes no damage but warps the party back to the beginning.

evidence.quote: You'll notice that the sides of this tower are unlike any other tower you've been to. That's because you can fall off this one! ... Amazingly, you don't take any damage, but you still get warped back to the beginning, which sucks even more.

subject: right path
text: In the Blue Tower, taking the first set of stairs on the right path leads to a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Now take the right path, and go up the first set of stairs to get a Hi Potion.

subject: left stairs
text: In the Blue Tower, going up the left stairs yields Hi Magic before heading to the next floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Hi Magic up the left stairs and head to the next floor.

subject: Blue Tower
text: Dropping down the stairs in the Blue Tower leads to a Revive and the Green Jade.

evidence.quote: Now, go back and drop down the stairs. Take the Revive and. . .the Green Jade!

subject: Dark Demon
text: Dark Demons in the Green Tower can cast Bolt, dealing about 80 damage to a party member.

evidence.quote: There are Dark Demons here that can cast Bolt, dealing about 80 damage to a party member.

subject: left room
text: The Green Ring is found in the left room of the Green Tower.

evidence.quote: Take the Green Ring from the left room.

subject: left stairs switch
text: In the Green Tower, taking the left stairs leads to a Magic Guard and a switch that opens another stairwell.

evidence.quote: The left stairs lead to a Magic Guard as well as a switch that opens a stairwell somewhere else.

subject: triggered stairway
text: Going up the triggered stairway in the Green Tower reveals an Ex Potion and a Revive, along with an untakeable broken Red Sapphire.

evidence.quote: Go up and find an Ex Potion and a Revive, as well as a broken Red Sapphire that you don't take with you =(.

subject: bottom steps
text: The bottom steps in the Green Tower yield Hi Magic, Revive, and Ex Potion, with a Swing Wing in the corner of the room.

evidence.quote: The bottom steps will reward you with a Hi Magic, Revive, and Ex Potion. Take the Swing Wing in the corner of the room, and then go back and switch the switch up.

subject: Golden Pawn
text: In Grenoble, you can enlist to find the Golden Pawn on Level 5 of the Old Cave for 3000 Gold.

evidence.quote: Since you're at Level 20, it's time to head back to the Old Cave to tackle Level 5. Warp to Grenoble and this time, enlist to find the Golden Pawn for 3000 Gold.

subject: Old Cave
text: Heading down upon entering Level 5 of the Old Cave leads to a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote: Once in the cave, head down and take the Smoke Ball.

subject: Luck Blade
text: The Luck Blade found in the lower room increases Aguro's attack by 200 and deals about 300 damage, but misses 50% of the time.

evidence.quote: Now, the Luck Blade. This thing is cursed, but it doesn't take down his HP. The thing that's wrong with this baby, is that it misses 50% of the time. But, if you do get a successful hit, it does about 300 damage to the monsters in here. It ups Aguro's attack by 200.

subject: lower muck puddle
text: Checking the top corner of the lower muck puddle on Level 5 of the Old Cave yields an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Back in the main room, check the top corner of the lower muck puddle for another Ex Potion.

subject: main room
text: Across from the muck puddle on Level 5 of the Old Cave, you can take the Kite Shield.

evidence.quote: On the other side, take the Kite Shield and head into the top room, plundering it.

subject: third door
text: Going through the third door on Level 5 of the Old Cave leads to the Battle Axe.

evidence.quote: Enter the middle room, take the treasure in there, and then go back and through the third door. Take the BATTLE AXE, another super-powerful weapon to add to your collection.

subject: muck
text: Walking up 7 and right 1 in the muck on Level 5 of the Old Cave allows you to take a Revive.

evidence.quote: Go up 7 and right 1 to take the Revive in the muck.

subject: treasure room
text: The old man in Medan Mine gives you his last Ruby and leaves his treasure room open.

evidence.quote: Talk to the old man, and he'll give you his last ruby. ... But the stupid old geezer leaves his treasure room door open! Ha! Go in there and take all his stuff to thank him for giving him your ruby!

subject: Flamefreak
text: Flamefreaks in the Red Tower cast Flame, dealing 30-40 damage to each party member and up to 160 damage when four attack together.

evidence.quote: The only thing really annoying about this place are those accursed Flamefreaks. They're insanely fast, and cast "Flame", and attack that hits everyone for 30-40 damage. Get four of them on you at once, they're dealing you 160 damage every turn.

subject: second floor
text: Entering the right room on the second floor of the Red Tower leads to Float.

evidence.quote: Go to the second floor, and enter the right room to get the Float.

subject: left path
text: Going down the left path on the second floor of the Red Tower leads to a Power Gourd and a Magic Guard.

evidence.quote: Go down the left path and take the Power Gourd and Magic Guard.

subject: hallway
text: Going down past the plaque hallway in the Red Tower yields a Hi Magic and a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Go down and take the Hi Magic and Hi Potion.

subject: stairs
text: Climbing the stairs directly above the third-floor entrance in the Red Tower leads to another Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Now go back to the second floor, and enter the lower left room and climb the steps to the third floor. Go up the stairs directly above you and get another Hi Potion.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: The Dark Ghost casts a 50-60 HP Water spell and is defeated on the fifth floor of the Red Tower, saving the Water Fairy.

evidence.quote: The only thing hard about him is his 50-60 HP Water spell. ... Send this guy back to Hell and then the Water Fairy will thank you.

subject: basement lake
text: After falling out of the Red Tower and returning to the basement lake, the chests refill and the Blue Jade is found.

evidence.quote: Now. . .fall out of the tower, then go back in down to the basement lake. The chests you took earlier have been re-filled, and the Blue Jade is now there.
